candidate_protocol_audit.candidate_source: train-set popularity/transitions/hyper-coactivation plus observed-prefix social neighbors

methodology: MINDS-style sequential hypergraph attention and dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory + FOREST-style masked next-user policy with sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency + CasFT continuous trend branch (original_gaussian_diffusion_st)
note: KT2 formal local joint model: prefix-feature encoder plus GRU sequence encoder, MINDS-style sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context with attention pooling and dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory, macro size head, micro next-hop policy head, CasFT-style Euler neural-ODE trend decoder, CasFT original GaussianDiffusion_ST auxiliary, and FOREST-style masked next-user policy plus sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency loss. It is not an original FOREST, MINDS, CasFT, DyGFormer, or HyperIDP reproduction.

research_migration.MINDS: sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context GRU with attention pooling, dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory with Fusion-style gated temporal aggregation, gradient-reversal task/stage adversaries, and macro/micro orthogonality regularizer approximate cross-cascade diffusion state and task disentanglement; this is a KT2 bridge, not original dhg-based MINDS Module full architecture
research_migration.FOREST: observed activation-sequence GRU, event-level masked next-user policy loss, REINFORCE-style sampled growth reward over legal candidates, macro-quality reward weighting, and macro/micro count-consistency constrain scale and next-hop predictions; this is a KT2 bridge, not original RRModel EOS rollout
research_migration.CasFT: trend branch uses an Euler neural-ODE-style decoder and calls CasFT's original GaussianDiffusion_ST/ST_Diffusion as an auxiliary loss on min-max normalized future trend checkpoints; it is still not the full CasFT temporal point-process encoder or full training protocol
research_migration.DyGFormer_TGN: micro branch remains a temporal next-hop ranking task over leak-checked candidates

joint_training.shared_encoder: fusion of prefix/candidate MLP, observed-sequence GRU, and cross-cascade context encoder
joint_training.sequence_encoder: GRU over observed t_obs activation sequence
joint_training.cross_context_encoder: GRU plus attention pooling over MINDS-style sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context fused with dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory
joint_training.minds_dynamic_hypergraph: event-level DynamicCasHGNN bridge: prefix user embeddings are aggregated as sequential hyperedges and fused over time with a MINDS-style Fusion gate
joint_training.trend_auxiliary: Euler neural-ODE-style trend decoder supervised on 4 future cumulative-size checkpoints
joint_training.diffusion_auxiliary: CasFT original GaussianDiffusion_ST auxiliary over min-max normalized future trend checkpoints
joint_training.adversarial_regularizer: gradient-reversal task/stage adversaries over shared propagation state
joint_training.reinforced_coupling: FOREST-style event policy bridge: masked next-user policy loss plus REINFORCE-style sampled growth reward over legal candidates
joint_training.methodology: MINDS sequential hypergraph attention plus dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory with adversarial disentanglement, FOREST masked next-user policy plus sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency, CasFT neural-ODE-style trend decoding with shared-state-conditioned denoising diffusion auxiliary
joint_training.trend_target: future cumulative cascade size checkpoints after t_obs
joint_training.consistency_loss: MSE(log1p(macro predicted growth), log1p(sum sigmoid(candidate logits))) plus macro-reward-weighted event-level masked next-user policy loss and FOREST-style sampled growth reward

note: Unified framework audit row; not a standalone paper-model reproduction.
